summary: Remove a sitemap from a GSC site. Requires site_url + feedpath and the full 'webmasters' scope. Irreversible.

params.name: feedpath
params.doc: Full sitemap URL to delete. Pydantic-required.

returns: await sc.delete_sitemap(conn_id, site_url, feedpath) → connector result | insufficient_scope error | _no_gsc() error

summary: Submit a sitemap for a GSC site. Requires site_url + feedpath. Requires the full 'webmasters' connection scope.

params.name: site_url
params.doc: GSC property. Pydantic-required (CoercedStr, not Optional) — a missing value raises a pydantic validation error, NOT a friendly bad_request.

params.name: feedpath
params.doc: Full sitemap URL to submit. Pydantic-required.

returns: await sc.submit_sitemap(conn_id, site_url, feedpath) → connector result | insufficient_scope error | _no_gsc() error
